brief: A ramp for my cat to walk up to the windowsill.

requirements.evidence: 3 full bases in a row at level 0 (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full) with 2 stacked at levels 1-2 forming 3 walk-up levels topped with full covers (cover:0,0,0, cover:1,0,1, cover:2,0,2); ~240mm top height; caps closed and joints locked
requirements.requirement: Ramp / stepped climb for a cat to walk up to the windowsill

finish.summary: Built a 3-step staircase ramp (ground, +1, +2 levels) with solid top covers as treads. Top platform ~240mm high. Verified clear with caps and locked joints. Sill-height fit and load/strength depend on user material and actual sill height and are not verified by the configurator.

lines.label: Edge cap · female, two stories tall
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
